info.name: Stratiq Backend API
info.description:
# Stratiq Backend REST API

Full CRUD API for inventory, order management, production, stock tracking and RBAC.

## Getting Started
1. Set the `baseUrl` environment variable (default: `http://localhost:8080`)
2. Run **Auth → Login** — the `token` and `refreshToken` are saved automatically
3. All other requests inherit JWT Bearer auth from the collection root

## Pagination
Paginated endpoints accept:
- `page` (0-based, default `0`)
- `size` (default `20`)
- `sort` (e.g. `createdAt,desc` or `stepOrder,asc`)

## Auth
JWT Bearer token, 24h expiry. Use **Auth → Refresh** to renew without re-login.

item.name: 🔐 Auth
item.description: Authentication endpoints — login, refresh, change password.

item.name: Login
item.description: Authenticate with email and password. On success, saves `token` and `refreshToken` to the active environment.

item.name: Refresh Token
item.description: Exchange a refresh token for a new access token.

item.name: Change Password
item.description: Change the authenticated user's password. Requires current password for verification.

item.name: 👥 Customers
item.description: Manage customers. Paginated list supports `page`, `size`, `sort` query params.

item.name: List Customers
item.description:
Returns a paginated list of all customers.

**Pagination params:**
- `page` — 0-based page index (default: 0)
- `size` — page size (default: 20)
- `sort` — field,direction e.g. `name,asc`

item.name: Get Customer
item.description: Fetch a single customer by UUID.

item.name: Create Customer
item.description: Create a new customer. Returns 201 with the created resource. The `id` is auto-saved to `customerId`.

item.name: Update Customer
item.description: Update an existing customer. All fields are optional (partial update).

item.name: Delete Customer
item.description: Permanently delete a customer. Returns 204 No Content.

item.name: 🏭 Warehouses
item.description: Manage storage locations/warehouses. Paginated with default sort by `createdAt` DESC.

item.name: List Warehouses
item.description:
Returns a paginated list of warehouses sorted by creation date (newest first).

**Default:** `size=20, sort=createdAt,desc`

item.name: 🚚 Suppliers
item.description: Manage suppliers/vendors. Paginated with default sort by `createdAt` DESC.

item.name: List Suppliers
item.description:
Returns a paginated list of suppliers sorted by creation date (newest first).

**Default:** `size=20, sort=createdAt,desc`

item.name: 🏷️ Categories
item.description: Asset/item categories. Paginated with default sort by `createdAt` DESC.

item.name: List Categories
item.description:
Returns a paginated list of categories.

**Default:** `size=20, sort=createdAt,desc`

item.name: 📦 Assets
item.description: Manage physical assets/products. Paginated list with optional category filter.

item.name: List Assets
item.description:
Returns a paginated list of all assets.

**Pagination params:**
- `page` (default: 0)
- `size` (default: 20)
- `sort` (e.g. `name,asc`)

item.name: 🧩 Items (Products/Components)
item.description:
Manage item master data (raw materials, finished goods). Non-paginated list; supports optional `categoryId` and `kind` filters.

`kind` values: `OWN_PRODUCT`, `PURCHASED`

item.name: List Items
item.description:
Returns all items as a flat list (not paginated).

**Optional filters:**
- `categoryId` — filter by category UUID
- `kind` — filter by kind: `OWN_PRODUCT` or `PURCHASED`

item.name: Create Item
item.description: `kind` values: `OWN_PRODUCT`, `PURCHASED`

item.name: 📋 Bills of Material (BOM)
item.description: Bill of Materials — defines which components are required for a finished item. Non-paginated. **Required filter:** `itemId`.

item.name: List BOM by Item
item.description: Returns all BOM entries for a given finished item. **`itemId` is required.**

item.name: Create BOM Entry
item.description: Add a component to a finished item's BOM. `quantity` is the amount of component needed. `unit` is a free-text unit.

item.name: 📦 Batches
item.description: Inventory batches — tracks stock per item/warehouse with expiry dates. Non-paginated list.

item.name: List Batches
item.description: Returns all batches as a flat list (not paginated).

item.name: Create Batch
item.description: `expiryDate` format: `2026-12-31T00:00:00`

item.name: 🛒 Orders
item.description:
Customer orders management. Paginated with default sort by `createdAt` DESC.

`status` values: `DRAFT`, `CONFIRMED`, `CANCELLED`, `COMPLETED`

item.name: List Orders
item.description:
Returns a paginated list of orders sorted by creation date (newest first).

**Default:** `size=20, sort=createdAt,desc`

item.name: Create Order
item.description:
`status` values: `DRAFT`, `CONFIRMED`, `CANCELLED`, `COMPLETED`
`orderDate`/`expectedDate` format: `2026-05-27T10:00:00`

item.name: 🛍️ Order Items
item.description:
Line items belonging to an order. Paginated or flat-list filter by `orderId`.

`unit` values: `piece`, `kg`, `g`, `l`, `ml`, `m`, `cm`, `m2`, `m3`, `hour`, `day`, `set`

item.name: List Order Items (paginated)
item.description:
Returns a paginated list of ALL order items across orders.

**Default:** `size=20, sort=createdAt,desc`

item.name: List Order Items by Order
item.description: Returns all items for a specific order as a flat list (not paginated).

item.name: Create Order Item
item.description: `unit` values: `piece`, `kg`, `g`, `l`, `ml`, `m`, `cm`, `m2`, `m3`, `hour`, `day`, `set`

item.name: ⚙️ Production Steps (Templates)
item.description: Production step templates linked to assets. Paginated with default sort by `stepOrder` ASC.

item.name: List Production Steps
item.description:
Returns a paginated list of production step templates.

**Default:** `size=20, sort=stepOrder,asc`

body.raw:
{
  "assetId": "{{assetId}}",
  "name": "Assembly Step 1",
  "description": "Mount the frame components",
  "stepOrder": 1,
  "notes": "Requires torque wrench"
}

item.name: 🔧 Order Production Steps
item.description:
Production steps attached to a specific order. Paginated or filtered by `orderId`.

`status` values: `PENDING`, `IN_PROGRESS`, `DONE`

item.name: List Order Production Steps (paginated)
item.description:
Returns a paginated list of all order production steps.

**Default:** `size=20, sort=stepOrder,asc`

item.name: List Order Production Steps by Order
item.description: Returns all production steps for a specific order as a flat list.

item.name: Create Order Production Step
item.description:
`status` values: `PENDING`, `IN_PROGRESS`, `DONE`
`stepOrder` must be ≥ 1.

item.name: 🏗️ Production Workflow
item.description: Higher-level production management — overview, step assignment, start/complete lifecycle.

item.name: Production Overview (paginated)
item.description: Returns a paginated view of all order production steps across all orders.

item.name: List Production Steps by Order
item.description: Returns all production steps for a given order. Non-paginated flat list.

item.name: Assign Step to User
item.description: Assign a production step to a user (worker).

item.name: Start Production Step
item.description: Mark a production step as IN_PROGRESS. Sets `startedAt` to current timestamp.

item.name: Complete Production Step
item.description: Mark a production step as DONE. Sets `completedAt` to current timestamp.

item.name: 🧾 Invoices
item.description:
Invoice management. Paginated with default sort by `createdAt` DESC.

`status` values: `ISSUED`, `PAID`, `CANCELLED`

item.name: List Invoices
item.description:
Returns a paginated list of invoices sorted by creation date (newest first).

**Default:** `size=20, sort=createdAt,desc`

item.name: Create Invoice
item.description:
`status` values: `ISSUED`, `PAID`, `CANCELLED`
Date format: `2026-05-27T10:00:00`

item.name: 📊 Stock Movements
item.description:
Track all stock movements (IN/OUT/TRANSFER). Paginated list + filter shortcuts by `assetId`, `warehouseId`, `orderId`, or `type`.

`type` values: `IN`, `OUT`, `TRANSFER`

item.name: List Stock Movements (paginated)
item.description: Returns a paginated list of all stock movements.

item.name: Filter by Asset
item.description: Returns all stock movements for a specific asset (flat list).

item.name: Filter by Warehouse
item.description: Returns all stock movements for a specific warehouse (flat list).

item.name: Filter by Type
item.description:
Returns all stock movements of a specific type (flat list).

`type` values: `IN`, `OUT`, `TRANSFER`

item.name: Create Stock Movement
item.description:
`type` values: `IN`, `OUT`, `TRANSFER`
`orderId` is optional.

item.name: 📈 Stock (Inventory Control)
item.description: Higher-level stock endpoints — movements view, inventory adjustments, and difference reports.

item.name: All Movements (paginated)
item.description: Returns a paginated list of stock movements via the stock service.

item.name: Stock Adjustment
item.description: Create a corrective stock adjustment. Creates a stock movement record with the given quantity.

item.name: Difference Report
item.description:
Returns a stock difference report. Optional filters:
- `assetId` — filter by asset
- `warehouseId` — filter by warehouse

item.name: 🔑 Roles
item.description: Role-based access control — manage roles. Non-paginated list (returns plain JSON array).

item.name: List Roles
item.description: Returns all roles as a plain JSON array (not paginated).

item.name: Assign Permissions to Role
item.description: Add permissions to a role. Send a list of `permissionIds` in the request body.

item.name: Remove Permissions from Role
item.description: Remove permissions from a role. **Requires a request body** with the list of `permissionIds` to remove.

item.name: 🛡️ Permissions
item.description: Manage available permissions. Non-paginated list (returns plain JSON array).

item.name: List Permissions
item.description: Returns all permissions as a plain JSON array (not paginated).

item.name: Create Permission
item.description: `codename` should be a unique machine-readable identifier (e.g. `inventory:read`).

item.name: 👤 Users
item.description: User management. Paginated list.

item.name: List Users
item.description: Returns a paginated list of all users.

item.name: Create User
item.description: Create a new user account. `roleId` links to an existing role.

item.name: Change User Role
item.description: Assign a different role to an existing user.

item.name: 📝 Audit Logs
item.description:
Read-only audit trail. Paginated with optional filters.

**Filters (mutually exclusive):**
- `userId` — all actions by a specific user
- `entityType` + `entityId` — all actions on a specific entity

item.name: List All Audit Logs
item.description: Returns a paginated list of all audit log entries.

item.name: Filter by User
item.description: Returns audit log entries for a specific user (paginated).

item.name: Filter by Entity
item.description:
Returns audit log entries for a specific entity (paginated).

`entityType` example: `Customer`, `Order`, `Asset`

query.description: Entity class name (e.g. Customer, Order, Asset)
